H=$(head -c3 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n'); C=k8s-lab-sts009lab-$H; echo $C > /root/workspace/DevTools/k/logs/009_statefulset/scratch/cname; mkdir -p /root/workspace/DevTools/k/logs/009_statefulset/lab-run
docker run -dit --name $C --hostname k8s-lab --privileged -p 2224:22 -p 30090-30092:30080-30082 tuchsanai/devtools-kind:2569_1 && timeout 60 docker exec $C bash -c 'until (echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/22) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; until docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done'; docker logs $C | grep -E 'cgroup v2|SSH key'; echo $C

cd /root/workspace/DevTools/k/logs/009_statefulset/scratch; cat > r.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ใช้: r.sh <labNN> <subdir ใต้ 02_LAB หรือ .> <<'X' ...คำสั่ง... X
C=$(cat /root/workspace/DevTools/k/logs/009_statefulset/scratch/cname)
LOG=/root/workspace/DevTools/k/logs/009_statefulset/lab-run/$1.log
DIR=$2
CMD=$(cat)
{ echo "### $(date -u +%T) (cd 02_LAB/$DIR)"; echo "$CMD" | sed 's/^/$ /'; } >> $LOG
printf 'cd /workspace/009_kubernetes_statefulset/02_LAB/%s\n%s\n' "$DIR" "$CMD" | docker exec -i $C bash 2>&1 | tee -a $LOG
echo >> $LOG
EOF
chmod +x r.sh; C=$(cat cname); docker exec $C mkdir -p /workspace && docker cp /root/workspace/DevTools/k/009_kubernetes_statefulset $C:/workspace/ && docker exec $C bash -c 'cd /workspace/009_kubernetes_statefulset/02_LAB && find . -type f -not -path "*/images/*" | wc -l; ls'
